title: Still stuck?
body: If you've tried the fixes above and you're still stuck, that's exactly what your Wednesday 1:1 is for. Your mentor's job is to help you think it through — not to have the answer memorised. Come to your check-in with:
bring: What actually happened — numbers, not vibes
Where, specifically, you think you're stuck
closing: Bring the problem, not just the frustration — that's what turns a 1:1 into real progress.
videoNote: A note on the videos in this guide: they're general tutorials from the wider internet, not BYOB or Mesa content — useful for the fundamentals, but always adapt the specifics to your product, budget, and campus context.
